dedupe_keys.name: quantifying reagent spreading by cross borehole electrical tomography to assess performance of groundwater remediation

description: Léa Lévy and collaborators publish electrical-tomography inputs, inversion outputs and acquisition protocols for monitoring groundwater remediation. Zenodo provides two ZIP archives with XML and TXT configurations free under CC BY 4.0. Cross-borehole resistivity and induced-polarisation measurements track injected zero-valent iron and its associated ionic cloud. Inputs are formatted for AarhusInv; the documented array uses two boreholes with thirty-two electrodes each. These data can benchmark geophysical observation models coupled to contaminant-treatment simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. The description reports that inferred hydraulic-conductivity patterns failed to predict some injection paths, possibly because injection created pathways. Site location, field dates and uncertainty remain unconfirmed here. Solver availability and compatibility are separate dependencies. No archive was downloaded, inversion executed or remediation effectiveness inferred from electrical anomalies alone.
